name: Nicolai Ferraino
bioAdditions: Nicola Ferraino was baptized on 20 October 1675, son of Carlo Ferraino and Giovanna Ianni; the index notes the family was from Martirano (S1). This is the earliest Ferlaino ancestor and suggests the surname reached San Mango from Martirano, the diocesan seat a few kilometres away. His parents are new to the tree.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Identification as Gaetano's father rests on the tree plus the 1743 marriage ("son of the late Nicola").
